types.name: DateRange
types.doc: An inclusive range of whole days.

types.name: DateRangePreset
types.doc: A shortcut in the preset rail. `range` receives the viewer's local today.

types.name: DateRangePickerProps
types.doc: A range picker whose trigger grows into the panel it opens. The panel shows two months beside a preset rail, or one month with a scrolling preset row when space is tight. The range highlight stretches across each week as you hover or move with the keyboard, the ends glide between days, months slide in the direction you travel, and on Apply the formatted label flies back into the trigger as the surface shrinks around it. Use it for reports, filters, and bookings where a start and end date are chosen together.

members.name: value
members.doc: Controlled value. Pass `null` for no selection.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the trigger and the dialog. Defaults to "Date range".

members.name: weekStartsOn
members.doc: 0 is Sunday, 1 is Monday. Defaults to 0.

members.name: months
members.doc: Force one or two months. `auto` picks two when the boundary is wide enough.

members.name: boundary
members.doc: The element the panel should stay inside. Defaults to the viewport.

members.name: formatters
members.type: { title: Intl.DateTimeFormat; day: Intl.DateTimeFormat; weekday: Intl.DateTimeFormat; weekdayLong: Intl.DateTimeFormat }
